## Technical reference

- [boot1 padding](../reference/em10-ii-1400.boot1-padding.md): 0xff padding inside the boot1 load, loaded at reset and unreferenced; fenykl's loader stub sits at 0x6005e000.
- [main-code-01 run address](../reference/em10-ii-1400.main-code-base.md): Offset 0 of the main-code-01 block runs at 0x60021020; boot0 and boot1 load at reset, the other sections later.
- [Usr3 card-mount flag](../reference/em10-ii-1400.mount-gate.md): u16 set to 1 only when Usr3 posted the card mount, on a power-switch boot; 0 on the other boots.
- [Never-loaded gap between sec4 and sec5](../reference/em10-ii-1400.payload-gap.md): 428 KiB of the image that no section load covers; fenykl reads FENYKL.BIN here and puts the loader stack after it.
- [Power-on factor word](../reference/em10-ii-1400.power-on-factor.md): u32 boot reason: 12 power switch, 0x1000001 battery connected, 0x400 USB cable, 0x1506 card inserted.
- [Never-loaded gap between sec5 and sec6](../reference/em10-ii-1400.sec5-sec6-gap.md): 534 KiB of the image outside every section load, usable once sec5 has loaded; fenykl's dev monitor runs test programs here.
- [Uncached DRAM alias rule](../reference/em10-ii-1400.uncached-alias.md): Cached DRAM 0x60000000 to 0x7fffffff; the uncached alias of a is (a & 0x3fffffff) | 0x80000000.
- [End of startup stage Usr3](../reference/em10-ii-1400.usr3-end.md): The call that ends the startup task Usr3; fenykl's loader patch replaces it with a call to its stub.
- [Stop card writes once a USB cable has been seen](../reference/hazard.card-writes-under-usb-storage.md): In USB storage mode the PC's sector writes go through the camera's file task while its FAT stays mounted.
- [Only call code in a section that has already loaded](../reference/hazard.section-load-order.md): Sections load one after another; a hook calling a later section can run before its target exists.
- [Block, never spin, at or above the watchdog task's priority](../reference/hazard.spin-starves-watchdog.md): The watchdog is kicked by one ordinary CPU0 task; a busy loop that outranks it lets the watchdog reset the camera.
- [A code patch refreshes only the patching core's I-cache](../reference/hazard.stale-icache-other-cores.md): The firmware has no cross-core way to publish code changes; other cores can keep running stale cached lines.
- [Remove a card-loaded payload before a PC firmware update](../reference/hazard.usb-update-with-card-payload.md): A PC/USB update runs inside the running application, so the loader and its payload are active while flash is written.
